paragraphs: An unguided rocket fired from an aircraft is the oldest air to ground weapon still in use, and it survives because it is cheap. The aeroplane does the aiming, the rocket does nothing clever at all, and against a target that is not moving that is often enough.

The model is extremely light at 1,782 polygons and 1,773 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, so a full pod of them costs almost nothing in a scene. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits defence and aviation visualisation, simulation, game assets, film props, documentary graphics and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

The warehouse robot did not automate picking, it automated walking. Instead of a person going to the shelf, the shelf comes to the person, and an entire building can be laid out with no aisles because nothing human has to move through it.

The model holds 114,502 polygons and 115,152 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 12 maps all at 4096x4096, supplied with the rack. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits warehouse and logistics visualisation, automation and robotics presentation, equipment marketing, training material, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2020.

Early military packs were rectangular because they were made from flat panels of canvas, and everything about how they carried followed from that: no frame, no shaping, and straps that had to do all the work of distributing a load the bag itself could not.
The model is very light at 7,145 polygons and 7,553 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplied with the straps. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits historical and period visualisation, film and television props, museum material, game characters, character accessories and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

Polar buildings stand on legs for two reasons: the snow drifts, and the ground beneath them must not thaw. Everything else about a field base follows from being resupplied a few times a year and having nowhere to send anybody who gets into trouble.
The model is light at 43,468 polygons and 51,502 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification.

At $49 it suits research and expedition visualisation, documentary and news graphics, climate and education material, film backgrounds, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

Barramundi is farmed across Asia and sold whole far more often than filleted, because the buyer wants to see the eye and the gills before agreeing a price. A fish lying on ice is a commercial pose rather than a natural one.
The model is extremely light at 3,940 polygons and 3,897 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 6 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits food and seafood marketing, retail and market scenes, packaging and menu imagery, education material, game props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2019.

A post mortem table is designed entirely around drainage and cleaning. The surface slopes, the sink is part of the table rather than beside it, and every edge is radiused because a joint that cannot be scrubbed is a joint that cannot be used.
The model holds 66,036 polygons and 67,106 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits medical and forensic visualisation, equipment marketing, education and training material, film and television sets, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The long peak and the extended chin bar on a motocross helmet are not styling. The peak shields against roost thrown up by the bike in front, and the chin bar is pushed forward to leave room for goggles and for breathing hard.
The model holds 38,114 polygons and 38,771 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 16 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits sports equipment and retail visualisation, e-commerce imagery, advertising, character accessories, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2020.

A hooded cloak is the most efficient costume ever devised. It covers everything, needs no fitting, works in any period from the medieval to the invented, and hides whatever the production could not afford to build underneath.

The garment holds 27,116 polygons and 27,104 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 11 maps, 6 at 4096x4096 and 5 at 2048x2048, in black. It carries StemCell certification.
At $49 it suits character wardrobe work, fantasy and historical film costume, game characters, concept art, previsualisation and editorial illustration. On sale since 2019.

The helmet of a bomb disposal suit has to do two contradictory things: stop fragments and let the wearer see well enough to do delicate work with their hands. The visor is the compromise, and it is thicker than most people imagine.
The model is light at 20,540 polygons and 22,048 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits defence and safety visualisation, protective equipment marketing, training material, character accessories, film props, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

The briefcase survived the laptop and the backpack by becoming a signal rather than a container. What somebody carries into a meeting says something before they open it, which is why the hard sided case has never entirely gone away.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the cases as static pieces. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 the set suits product and retail visualisation, e-commerce imagery, office and interior scenes, advertising, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

Temple statuary is built to be approached from below. The proportions are adjusted for that viewing angle, the hands are placed where they will read against the sky, and a photograph taken level with the face rarely looks like the object anyone remembers.
The model holds 188,724 polygons and 98,978 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits cultural and religious visualisation, tourism and travel imagery, architectural scenes, documentary work, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

A drone made of waxed cardboard arrives flat packed, is assembled with tape in under an hour, and is not expected to come back. It was designed as cheap logistics and turned out to be cheap almost everything else, which is a lesson the industry is still absorbing.
The model is light at 19,416 polygons and 9,852 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in the flying configuration. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 it suits defence and technology visualisation, news and documentary graphics, logistics and innovation presentation, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2024.

A stylised planet does a job a photographic one cannot: it can be smiled at, labelled, thrown into a diagram or shrunk to an icon and still read as a world. That is why children's media and infographics both keep reinventing the same simplified globe.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the planets as static pieces. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $49 the set suits education and children's media, animation and motion graphics, infographic and editorial illustration, advertising and game assets. On sale since 2024.

Infused oil is sold on how it looks in the bottle. The chilli and the rosemary suspended in it are the label, the marketing and the proof of contents all at once, which is why the bottle is always clear and always slightly overfilled.
The model is light at 16,393 polygons and 16,476 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $49 it suits food and beverage visualisation, packaging and label mockups, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, kitchen scenes and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.
